cells.text: 10 of the 14 cases (smallest sdc-trial 59267: a 4 x 4 x 4 field map at 1 mm, zooms_min 4): BSplineApprox's resize gives a grid of one voxel, and nitransforms' Affine.apply fails there with a bare AssertionError (assert targets.ndim == 2 after numpy's squeeze of the one target point); the replica raised an AssertionError with its own message. Registered as SDC-11 (rule A): the voxel resampled and the fit made by default,…

2 of the 14 cases (sdc-trial 236468, 325222): the error map's cal_max is numpy's max of sdcflows' error array, which is Fortran-ordered (nibabel's arrays); numpy's SIMD max returns a new NaN or a zero's sign by memory order, and the replica's array was C-ordered: the replica keeps the error in Fortran order

2 of the 14 cases (sdc-trial 200937, 320850): recentring by the mode where the mode is 0 and the zeros have both signs (one -0 among 1,609 and 2,934 +0): scipy's mode is the first zero of np.unique's sort (+0 here; numpy's unstable SIMD quicksort leaves which zero is first undefined), the replica took -0 (the total order's first); the replica now takes the zeros' more frequent sign (+0 on a tie); only zero signs of the erro…

1 case (sdc-trial 294008: apply of a uint8 series, order 2, grid-constant, cval -5): lx.ndimage names SCI-02 when the spline prefilter pads an integer input with a cval its type cannot hold, whether or not a sample point reaches the padding (a condition whose effect the comparison may not see); the suite's fix pass of apply accepts SCI-02 without a change (silent_ok), as it does no other defect

examples.title: SDC-10: the field on an oblique BOLD reference, sdcflows' and the corrected one
examples.summary: sdcflows evaluates a field map on an EPI target with `B0FieldTransform.fit` (the first step of `ApplyCoeffsField` and of its unwarping workflow). When the target is not aligned with the coefficients' grid it takes an approximation: a fine aligned grid around the target, then cubic B-splines onto the target. sdcflows builds that grid around the target as given and samples it there, ignoring the registration (`xfm_data2fmap`); the field is taken where the target lies before it is registered. fMRIPrep's own reconstruction never takes this path (it refuses grids that are not aligned); sdcflows' unwarping does. ds002603's oblique BOLD reference with fMRIPrep's registration to the field map, against the exact field.
